data.title: Bridgeline Digital Faces Nasdaq Minimum Bid Price Deficiency
data.description:

Under Nasdaq rules, the company now has an initial 180-day compliance period, until April 12, 2027, to restore its share price to at least $1.00 for ten consecutive business days.

If Bridgeline Digital does not regain compliance in this initial window, it may qualify for an additional 180-day period provided it meets other Nasdaq Capital Market listing standards and notifies Nasdaq of its plan to cure the deficiency. The notice does not trigger an immediate delisting, and the company said it will continue monitoring its closing bid price and evaluate options, a development that underscores potential listing risk and may heighten uncertainty for shareholders.
